mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_match_rule (product_id, variant_id, match_type, target_field, pattern_value, match_fields, conditions_json, priority, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{variantId}, #{matchType}, #{targetField}, #{patternValue}, #{matchFields}, #{conditionsJson}, #{priority}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_match_rule WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT r.* FROM product_match_rule r INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.is_active = 1 AND p.is_active = 1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.priority ASC, r.priority ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT r.* FROM product_match_rule r WHERE r.is_active = 1 AND r.variant_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.priority ASC, r.id ASC
